noWorkspace: There is no AI workspace or git repository here (.bot-secure/policy.json).
badSeverity: Unknown severity: {severity}. Use CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, INFO or NONE.
scanDone: Scan finished: {findings} finding(s) across {files} file(s), {ms} ms.
moreRows: … and {count} more finding(s) in the report.
failOnHit: {count} finding(s) at severity {severity} or above: review the report and rotate what applies.
stagedEmpty: Nothing staged in git: nothing was scanned.
baselineIgnored: The baseline could not be read ({message}): scanning without suppressions.
leakAction: This value belongs to the AI environment: it must not exist outside .env.ai, .env.example, docs/ or the generated files.
gitleaksMissing: gitleaks is not installed: scanning with the native engine only.
gitleaksFailed: gitleaks failed ({reason}): scanning with the native engine only.
gitleaksDone: gitleaks {version}: {count} finding(s) rescanned with the native engine.
baselineNoExpiry: No expiry date: add --expires so it does not live forever.
secondPerson: {fp} is HIGH or CRITICAL: the exception stays PENDING until a second person approves it with bot-secure baseline approve {fp} --by another.person (the CI gate rejects them).
baselineNoFingerprint: The finding fingerprint is missing for baseline {sub}.
reasonRequired: {fp} is {severity}: --reason is required and a second person must approve it.
approveNeedsBy: --by is missing: the second approval must carry the name of whoever gives it.
pendingApprovals: {count} exception(s) are waiting for a second person's approval.
reportUnreadable: Report {path} could not be read: scanning again.
nothingToSanitize: The latest report has no findings: there is nothing to sanitize.
assumingDryRun: Without --apply: showing what would change, writing nothing.
refactorFailed: applyRefactors failed ({message}): this command's own changes were written.
sanitizeSummary: {proposals} automatic change(s) and {manual} left to do by hand.
sanitizeApplied: Sanitized: {files} file(s) changed and {rules} rule(s) written.
rulesOutsideRepo: The rules contain REAL VALUES and live outside the repository: {path}. Do not commit or share them.
nextApply: If the diff looks right: bot-secure sanitize --apply
mirrorNextVersion: History rewriting (--mirror) is coming in the next version.
todoRules: Rules with real values (outside the repo): `{path}`
todoCount: {proposals} automatic change(s) · {manual} left to do by hand
todoFooter: Remember: an exposed secret must be rotated even after it leaves the code. Record the rotation with `bot-secure attest --rotation-id <ticket>`.
attestNoReport: No report yet: the manifest will go without the scan hash.
attestDrift: Careful: {count} generated file(s) were edited by hand (drift).
attestNext: Hand this file to Security together with the report.
ciRequiredCheck: Make the "bot-secure" check required on the {branch} branch.
ciRequiredCheckHow: On GitHub: Settings → Rules → Rulesets → Require status checks to pass → bot-secure.
orgpackNext: Next step: hand infosec/ to the Security team so they apply the organization rules.
orgpackNextOwner: Next step: hand infosec/ to {owner} so they apply the organization rules.
syncQuarantined: {app}: {count} finding(s) in the range. Nothing was merged; quarantine at {path}.
syncNoRemote: {app}: no remote configured, so there is nowhere to bring changes from.
syncNotFf: {app}: {ai} cannot move forward without a merge commit (someone wrote on the AI branch).
syncNoOpen: There are no open task branches.
quarantineNext: What to do: rotate the affected secrets at their source, sanitize the commit on `dev` (`bot-secure sanitize --apply`) and run `bot-secure sync` again. Escalate to the Security owner if the deadline passes.
doctorFailed: The diagnosis failed ({message}): the manifest goes without it.
